paths.description: Homepage and primary video-listing template; covers first impression, navigation, responsive cards, search entry, performance, privacy, and crawler rendering.
Representative category/listing template, selected from the primary navigation; represents category and filtered catalog pages.
Representative search-results journey using the visible search form; verifies query navigation and results continuity.
Representative video-detail and playback page; covers the primary content flow, media semantics, metadata, and repeated play/pause memory behavior.
Terms, age statement, copyright, advertising, and contact template; covers trust and legal-information accessibility.
Representative failed route; verifies HTTP/network failure recovery rather than silently assuming happy-path behavior.

findings.summary: The site hard-codes a dark palette instead of adapting to the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The preference probe reports computed color-scheme: normal and the DOM stylesheet contains fixed #111/#222/#333 colors with no prefers-color-scheme rule; the only media rules are viewport-width queries.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and derive foreground/surface colors with light-dark() or prefers-color-scheme so both user preferences receive an intentional palette.

findings.summary: Full-page route changes are abrupt despite a navigation-heavy MPA.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection across homepage, category, detail, search, and info templates found no @view-transition rule or view-transition-name; the pages navigate as separate documents.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-origin cross-document View Transitions with a conservative fade and stable names for the header/content, while honoring prefers-reduced-motion.

findings.summary: The 7,156px listing provides no scroll-state-aware navigation or progress affordance.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout reports a 7,156px document. CSS/DOM inspection found no sticky header, scroll progress, scroll-state container query, or other positional feedback; all navigation scrolls away.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact sticky header that responds to scroll state, or add a lightweight progress/back-to-top affordance without covering content.

findings.summary: Header controls are small and keyboard focus is difficult to see.
findings.evidence: The focus probe measured the search button and primary navigation at 26px high and reported the browser focus outline as a 1px rgb(16,16,16) outline against the #111 background.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase compact controls to at least a comfortable touch target and add a high-contrast :focus-visible ring with spacing that remains visible on the dark surface.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus styling does not provide a clear visible focus path.
findings.evidence: A scripted focus walk across the first 20 controls found every control using only a 1px near-black auto outline on the near-black page; this makes focus location visually ambiguous despite logical source order.
findings.suggestedFix: Define a prominent, consistent :focus-visible outline/box-shadow and verify the entire header, card grid, pagination, and footer with keyboard-only navigation.

findings.summary: Unknown URLs end at the server’s bare nginx 404 with no recovery action.
findings.evidence: The exercised failure URL returned a page titled “404 Not Found” containing only the nginx heading, with no viewport meta, site navigation, search, retry, or link back to the catalog.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404 through the normal site shell with a concise explanation, search, Home link, and relevant categories; preserve the correct 404 status.

findings.summary: The listing eagerly fetches some below-fold thumbnails and leaves measurable image savings.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 3 below-fold images marked loading=eager and Lighthouse estimated 49 KiB image-delivery savings; the HAR transferred 267,134 image bytes of 290,974 total.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep only actual LCP candidates eager/high-priority, lazy-load all below-fold thumbnails, and generate appropriately compressed WebP/AVIF variants where savings remain.

findings.summary: Public templates omit canonical URLs and the sitemap endpoint returns 404.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found no rel=canonical on the homepage, category, search, or detail templates; the direct /sitemap.xml request returned HTTP 404 while robots.txt otherwise permits general crawling.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit a self-referential canonical for indexable templates, choose a canonical policy for search/filter pages, and publish a sitemap referenced from robots.txt.

findings.summary: Video detail pages lack structured and social share metadata.
findings.evidence: The detail probe found no JSON-LD and no Open Graph metadata despite a visible title, poster, duration, and media URL that could populate VideoObject and share previews.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter metadata derived from the visible detail-page content, including canonical URL, name, thumbnail, duration, and content URL.

findings.summary: All observed first-party cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None; the id cookie is also script-readable.
findings.evidence: The cookie audit observed three cookies (t, bookmark, id), all without Secure and all SameSite=None; id was not HttpOnly. Strong CSP/HSTS headers do not compensate for weak cookie attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure on all HTTPS cookies, default to SameSite=Lax or Strict unless cross-site use is essential, and make any server-issued identifier HttpOnly; document whether id is authentication-sensitive.

findings.summary: Navigation code conditionally opens the intended destination in a new tab and rewrites the clicked link to an advertising redirect.
findings.evidence: The rendered homepage source registers a capture-phase click listener that calls window.open(a.href, _blank) for card/category/info links and then changes a.href to /out/pop when cookie/referrer conditions pass. This is an unexpected pop-under/redirect pattern.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the capture-phase navigation interception. Keep the user’s chosen destination in the current tab and label any advertising link explicitly before activation.

findings.summary: The representative media detail provides no caption track or equivalent.
findings.evidence: The detail DOM/probe found a native video element with controls but no <track> caption child or adjacent transcript/caption control.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide WebVTT captions for spoken/audio content and a transcript or equivalent where appropriate; expose the available language in the player.

findings.summary: Body and metadata text is unusually small for sustained reading.
findings.evidence: The stylesheet sets body and several metadata regions to 9pt, and the mobile/desktop screenshots show dense small labels and legal text; the information page uses the same 9pt base.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a responsive rem-based type scale with a readable body minimum, increased line-height, and spacing that preserves the compact grid without shrinking essential metadata.
